subject: Project idea and looks for mentors

messages.author: 8f8f51bd41e07a5d
messages.subject: Project idea and looks for mentors
parts:
Hi,

I am an undergraduate student and have a project idea about wrapping the TnT javascript library in R to provide interactive genomic visualizations (a simple genome browser).
I have already added a wiki page at https://github.com/rstats-gsoc/gsoc2017/wiki/Interactive-Genome-Browser-in-R, and you can see my attempt at https://github.com/Marlin-Na/TnT.

According to instructions on the wiki, I am here looking for possible mentors, please see if you are willing to mentor this project.

Thanks !

Jialin

messages.author: 91d503f5958d266c
messages.subject: Re: Project idea and looks for mentors
parts: Hey JIalin that is a great idea. I would recommend that you have one mentor from the TnT authors, and another mentor from the R community. Please email the TnT authors to see if they would be interested in mentoring. If so, I would consider co-mentoring from the R side.
